concrete_difference: Official main.m derives phase vital signal from raw beatingTone_time and selected FFT range bin; current runner consumes VS_DATASET VitalSig directly
Both subtract a 0.3-Hz low-pass estimate but official uses a 300th-order FIR filter while Python uses a 4th-order Butterworth filter
Official calls HRestim.m after band-limited FFT peak candidates; Python selects the maximum rFFT power frequency and does not implement HRestim
Official builds an average pulse template from preliminary detected pulses; Python uses a deterministic sinusoidal template
Official flips the data-derived pulse template and applies adaptive matched filtering; Python convolves with the sinusoidal template
Official uses MATLAB findpeaks with period-derived MinPeakDistance and fixed MinPeakProminence 0.02; Python uses scipy find_peaks with fixed relative prominence
